QuestInfo.0: The memories of battle swirl through your mind, reminding you of your strength and power.
QuestInfo.1: As you resolve yourself to improve, you feel strength build within you.
QuestInfo.2: It becomes clear that staying true to yourself will always bring you closer to your goals.
